name: document-systems
description: Experimental tools for compiling, validating, rendering, and verifying content-addressed document-system proposals.

interface.longDescription: Experimental research prototype for building immutable proposal Expressions from four bounded document profiles, checking caller-supplied invariants, compiling portable packets, and rendering traceable views. Product utility over ordinary review is unproven. The plugin writes nothing and cannot make a document correct, operative, or accepted.
defaultPrompt: Model this document need as a proposal-scoped Expression.
Audit this Expression's integrity, semantic invariants, lineage, and evidence boundaries.
Compile a portable human-action release packet from this Expression.
